name: sg-pilot-v2: E4 at 5M steps with faster duals
question: Do aggregate_loose (x_h + x_v <= 2, fixed weights 1/d_i) and multi converge given 2.5x the steps of E4 and a faster multi dual?

code.commit: afe85f2 (aggregate_loose runs: fe872d5); multi runs use the commit that removed the pi0 code, budget path bit-identical

dual_lr_reason: multi 0.04 matches the growth rate of the shared multiplier at 0.02 (E5a reasoning); aggregate_loose keeps E4's 0.02

evaluation.checkpoint_eval: 10 episodes, environment seed 10000+seed, every 25 updates, chunk 2 (differs from E4's chunk 10)
evaluation.final_eval: 50 episodes, environment seed 200000+seed, action seed 300000+seed, chunk 2

commands: nice -n 10 python run_pilot.py --group sg-pilot-v2-loose --methods aggregate_loose --budget-hazard 31.9 --budget-vase 73.9 --transitions 5000000 --device cpu --max-parallel 3
nice -n 10 python run_pilot.py --group sg-pilot-v2-multi --methods multi --budget-hazard 31.9 --budget-vase 73.9 --transitions 5000000 --device cpu --max-parallel 3 --extra "--dual-lr 0.04"
output: runs/sg-pilot-v2-loose/, runs/sg-pilot-v2-multi/ on c2h1's lab machine (20 cores, 15 GB); W&B offline
rename_pending: after all runs finish: runs/sg-pilot-v2-loose -> runs/spg-v2-aggregate-loose, runs/sg-pilot-v2-multi -> runs/spg-v2-multi, this file -> spg-v2.json (progress.md TODO). W&B groups already use the new names. Run config.json files keep the old group names.
notes: Interpretation A of the professor's suggestion (fixed weights, sum <= 2); interpretation B (violation-adaptive weights) is open for the next lab meeting (progress.md).
